cohort: The study included 189 pregnant women diagnosed with chronic inflammatory arthritis (RA, SpA, or PsA) who delivered at Hamad General Hospital between 2016 and 2022.
finding: Pregnancy outcomes varied significantly across chronic inflammatory arthritis subtypes, with SpA being associated with higher live birth rates and lower risks of miscarriage, peripartum complications, and low birth weight compared to RA.
mod_finding: The study collected data on the mode of delivery but did not report any specific findings or associations related to it.
birth_weight: Birth weight and low birth weight (LBW) were measured outcomes.
gest_age: Weeks of gestation and preterm birth were measured outcomes.
